title: Small seated pelvic and spine exploration
summary: An invented, slow exploration of small pelvic shifts and the response through the lower spine.

instruction.exploration: Notice whether the pelvis can travel in a small, easy path without trying to reach an endpoint.

attention.cue: Notice the contact with the chair before beginning.
Compare the ease of the forward and backward directions.

range.smaller_reference: Make the path small enough that breathing and attention remain unhurried.

rest_pauses.note: Return to neutral and notice any change before repeating.

variations.note: Use an almost-imagined shift rather than a visible movement.

cautions: Stop if the seated movement increases pain, dizziness, or numbness.
safety.notes: Educational visualization only; this is project-authored wording, not an individualized lesson.

source.tradition_basis: Project-authored description informed by general Feldenkrais principles of attention, variation, and optional range; no lesson text or recording was copied.
source.rights_basis: provisional: project-authored movement description with no third-party lesson text, recording, or protected asset
